research.title: Research-Backed Methodology
research.subtitle: Our career guidance system integrates cutting-edge frameworks and scientifically-validated assessments
research.personalityDesc: Scientifically-validated personality assessment matching six career themes to individual interests
research.valuesDesc: Cross-culturally validated assessment measuring 10 basic human values for value-based career alignment
research.quizDesc: Curriculum-aligned knowledge validation that confirms academic strengths for career-path recommendations
research.wefDesc: World Economic Forum's 16 essential future-ready skills across Foundational Literacies and Core Competencies
research.visionDesc: Aligns career paths with country-specific development goals including UAE Centennial 2071
research.curriculumDesc: 240 grade-differentiated questions covering core subjects aligned with UAE national curriculum standards
research.approachDesc: We map existing, research-validated assessments to the World Economic Forum's 16 future-ready skills framework, providing students with comprehensive insights into their career readiness. By integrating personality, values, and competencies, we deliver personalized career recommendations that align with both individual strengths and national development priorities.
